headline: Stop Drowning in Property Data - Get Clarity Instead
transcript_text: Most buyers don't need more data. They need clarity. In Singapore, property data is everywhere. Everyone tells you to consider this, check that and analyse another thing. But after doing all of that homework, you feel more lost than before. So you hesitate, while the market moves on without you. So what you need isn't to be overloaded with more information. Instead, you need to filter out what actually matters. So instead of guessing or waiting indefinitely, you can make a decision today that can help you to grow your wealth for tomorrow. A good property decision can be made by considering these few things. I call them the 3 P's. Profitability of past projects in the surrounding area, present transactions, and potential prices in the future. Let's take an example of 3 bedrooms in the River Valley area. On profitability of past projects in the area, all the freehold projects actually recorded profitable transactions over the past 5 years, while leasehold projects recorded some unprofitable transactions. So, there is some evidence that freehold projects in the area might hold value better than leasehold projects, but a deeper analysis needs to be done, for example looking at holding periods before we come to a conclusion. On the next P, we look at present transactions. Comparing the leasehold projects, we can see that OUE Twin Peaks, which recorded the most number of unprofitable transactions, currently transacts on average at $3.67 million, while Spring Growth and Erwell Hill which has the least unprofitable transactions currently transacts at million and million respectively So if you looking to purchase a leasehold project in the River Valley area today I think a safe bet would be to enter at anything under $3.3 million, since the market has shown some resistance at $3.67 million. Furthermore, when we include the new projects in the area, namely Zion Grand, Promenade as well as Wivergreen, you can see why all these three projects generally sold well, since the average transacted value is relatively affordable. On the last P on potential prices, the newest plot of land is Wivermodern, which would have done its launch weekend by the time that you watch this video. The developer has already come out to announce that starting from prices for the three bedroom units will be from $2.298 million. Now taking a 30% premium as an estimate for the average transacted unit since they are larger 3 bedroom sizes. This means that the development will sell at about $2.98 million on average. So given this, then newer leasehold projects in the area are actually quite competitive compared to existing developments from an entry and an exit perspective. However, that's not all. Once you have decided on the location, then we have to look at the individual projects and stacks so that you can maximize your chances that you can grow your wealth and enjoy the capital appreciation. This is where personalized advice comes in. So if you're considering purchasing private property and want clarity before committing, reach out to me by filling the form below. Happy to walk you through how I usually plan with my clients.
